title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“啥玩意儿？”陈轩瞬间怀疑自己听错了。七色神莲是很珍贵的灵植，具有强化灵根，提高自己天赋上限的神奇作用。要知道寻常灵植大多数作用都是增加修为，并不能提高自己的上限。因此这七色神莲可以说是无比珍贵，有价无市。这只菜猫竟然能带来这等好事？“喵~本喵从不骗人呢。”“之前本喵在天玄宗附近寻找出路之时，曾在后山下面的悬崖中发现了一个隐秘的平台，里面就有一株七色神莲呢。”“后山。”陈轩若有所思。天玄宗后山灵气极为充沛，孕育出一株七色神莲也情有可原。去看看？陈轩知道自己现在只能躺平，不能主动变强，这七色神莲对自己没用。但可以拿来送给柳清霜啊！七色神莲增强了柳清霜的天赋，强化了灵根，然后再十倍作用在陈轩身上。这可不得了！而且送出一株七色神莲，可是会返回来十株！拿出去买了不也能大赚一笔！去瞧瞧！陈轩当即按照菜猫的指示前往后山。途中，他亦是问道：“对了菜猫，你舍弃了肉体，之后怎么恢复回去啊？”“我可不会替你保护肉体啊。”说完，他就感受到了菜猫发出的抗议情绪。“本喵不叫菜猫！”“哦，那你叫什么？”“本喵叫黑曜大王！”它对自己的名字很自傲，似乎叫了这么吊炸天的名字就能变得威武霸气似的。实则只是个脑子不太好使的菜猫。它继续说道：“本喵的肉体不重要，只要灵魂健全，之后随便找个猫类肉体就能复原。”“公的母的都可以？”“最好是母的喵。”“懂了。”

以后偏给你找个公的。两刻钟后刚到后山，陈轩就迎面碰上了杜青峰和几个执法堂的弟子。“杜长老！”陈轩恭敬施礼。“陈公子，你来后山作甚？”杜青峰一看见陈轩就气不打一处来。陈轩和煦笑道：“今天天气不错，来后山野个炊。”话罢他提了提手中的食盒。去后山得路过一众修炼场，他当然得做做伪装了。不然鬼鬼祟祟地去后山干嘛？“你！”杜青峰见状又是脸色铁青：“外门弟子的考核已经开始了，其他弟子都在通宵修炼，你还不抓紧时间想想办法？”“想啥办法？又不是一次两次了。”陈轩摊摊手。“烂泥扶不上墙！”杜青峰满脸无奈：“陈轩，虽然宗门看在你爹的面子上，不会赶你走。”“但做人得知道些廉耻才行，我是看着你长大的，能不急吗？”“这次考核非同小可，你要是再吊儿郎当的，我也不好替你说话了。”“哪怕是练练武，让长老们看到你的努力也行啊。”陈轩扣了扣耳朵，只是点头。“嗯。”见他还没听进去，杜青峰彻底无语了。“行吧，你自己看着办吧，我没时间跟你瞎扯了。”“怎么了这是？”“御兽峰跑了个灵兽，得抓紧时间找到。”“哦哦。”“记住我的话，上点心！”“知道了。”片刻后陈轩来到了后山悬崖边。下面云岚环绕，深不可测。“你确定七色神莲在下面？”“确定喵。”
content_en:
"What the hell?" Chen Xuan instantly suspected that he had heard wrongly.The seven-color divine lotus is a very precious spiritual plant, which has the magical effect of strengthening spiritual roots and increasing the upper limit of one's talent.You must know that most of the functions of ordinary spiritual plants are to increase your cultivation level and cannot increase your upper limit.Therefore, this seven-color sacred lotus can be said to be extremely precious, with a price but no market.This vegetable cat can actually bring such good things?"Meow~ I never lie to people." "When I was looking for a way out near Tianxuan Sect, I found a secret platform in the cliff below the back mountain, and there was a seven-color sacred lotus inside." "Back mountain." Chen Xuan thought thoughtfully.The mountain behind Tianxuan Sect is extremely rich in spiritual energy, so it is understandable that a seven-color sacred lotus was born.Go and have a look?Chen Xuan knew that he could only lie flat now and could not take the initiative to become stronger. This seven-color divine lotus was of no use to him.But you can give it to Liu Qingshuang!The seven-color divine lotus enhanced Liu Qingshuang's talent, strengthened her spiritual roots, and then acted on Chen Xuan tenfold.This is incredible!And if you send one seven-color sacred lotus, ten will come back!If you take it out and buy it, you can make a lot of money!Go and have a look!Chen Xuan immediately followed Caimao's instructions and headed to the back mountain.On the way, he also asked: "By the way, Caimao, you gave up your body, how do you get it back?" "I won't protect your body for you." After saying that, he felt Caimao's protest."My name is not Cai Mao!" "Oh, what is your name?" "My name is Obsidian King!" It is very proud of its name, as if it can become powerful and domineering by calling such a ridiculous name.In fact, he is just a rookie cat with a bad brain.It continued: "The body of this cat is not important. As long as the soul is sound, I can find any cat body to recover." "It can be a male or a female?" "It's best to be a female cat." "Understood."

I will find a male for you from now on.As soon as he arrived at the back mountain two quarters of an hour later, Chen Xuan met Du Qingfeng and several disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall."Elder Du!" Chen Xuan saluted respectfully."Mr. Chen, what are you doing here?" Du Qingfeng became furious when he saw Chen Xuan.Chen Xuan smiled warmly and said, "The weather is nice today. Let's have a picnic in the back mountain." After saying this, he picked up the food box in his hand.He had to pass a lot of training grounds on his way to the back mountain, so of course he had to put on a disguise.Otherwise, why are you sneaking to the back mountain?"You!" Du Qingfeng's face turned pale again when he saw this: "The assessment for the outer disciples has already begun. The other disciples are practicing all night long. Why don't you hurry up and think of a solution?" "What are you thinking of? It's not just once or twice." Chen Xuan spread his hands."Mud can't hold up a wall!" Du Qingfeng looked helpless: "Chen Xuan, although the sect won't drive you away for your father's sake." "But you have to know some sense of shame to be a human being. I watched you grow up, can you not be anxious?"This assessment is not trivial. If you continue to act carelessly, I won't be able to speak for you.""Even if you are practicing martial arts, let the elders see your efforts."Chen Xuan clasped his ears and just nodded."Yeah." Seeing that he hadn't listened yet, Du Qingfeng was completely speechless."Okay, you can figure it out for yourself. I don't have time to talk nonsense with you." "What's wrong?" "A spiritual beast escaped from Yushou Peak. We must find it as soon as possible." "Oh." "Remember my words and have some snacks!" "Got it." After a while, Chen Xuan came to the cliff of the back mountain.The sky below is surrounded by clouds and is unfathomable."Are you sure the Seven-Colored Divine Lotus is down there?" "Sure, meow."
